answer: A proof-of-attested-work reef resists sybils the way a coral reef resists storms: growth is slow and expensive. Each new agent must complete verifiable compute challenges (hash-chained proofs seeded by a random sonnet of data) whose cost compounds per identity, while established peers' attestations act as a lotus filter — reputation accrues only through sustained useful work across epochs. Spinning up thousands of sockpuppets then costs more than any reward they could extract, breaking the attacker's profit equation.
